title: Without Customers Create & Edit, Move Customers is greyed
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: A user whose custom role has AP/AR Data access but cannot edit customers opens Move Customers.
  • You are signed in as {User-A}, on a custom role, {Role-A}, that has Settings → Finance and View and Manage AP/AR Data, but not Customers → Create & Edit (and whatever it needs to reach Settings), and nothing else that matters here.
    For example: {User-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-28 User and {Role-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-28 Role.
  • Net 30 is held by at least one customer, and the shop's own term {Term-A} by none.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-28 Fourteen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 30" row.
  2. Hover "Move Customers".
  3. Click "Move Customers".
  4. Press Escape.
  5. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  6. Hover "Move Customers".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu shows "Move Customers" greyed out, while "Make Default for New Customers" and "Deactivate" are available.
  • Step 2: the hover reads "You need Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data to move customers."
  • Step 3: nothing happens; no window opens.
  • Step 4: the menu closes.
  • Step 5: "Move Customers" is greyed here too.
  • Step 6: the hover reads "You need Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data to move customers." (the permission reason, not the no-customers reason).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions), story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-N1: “If the user has 'Settings → Finance' but lacks 'Customers → Create & Edit' or 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', "Move Customers" shows greyed in every row menu with the hover text "You need Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data to move customers." A move sent by other means without all three permissions is refused by the server.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover a greyed Move Customers (missing permission) | "You need Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data to move customers." | Tooltip on hover, item greyed”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “Move Customers additionally needs 'Customers → Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', because it changes customer records;”
  • Key Decisions: “Departure: Move Customers keeps a gate from another area on a Settings page. It needs 'Customers → Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' as well as 'Settings → Finance'.”
  • S2-R1 table, Move Customers row: “"Move Customers" (person) | Every term, active or inactive | The user lacks 'Customers → Create & Edit' or 'View and Manage AP/AR Data': "You need Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data to move customers." Otherwise no customer holds the term: "No customers are on this term"”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “Viewing and using the Credit Terms page (the list, New Credit Term, Edit, Make Default, Deactivate, Reactivate, Delete) is governed by 'Settings → Finance', the same permission as Payment Methods.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "2 Move customers to another term" ("Without the customer permissions"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p2-09-without-the-customer-permissions.png

The design's own words:

  • “A user with Settings → Finance but without Customers → Create & Edit or View and Manage AP/AR Data sees Move Customers greyed in every row menu, with the hover text "You need Customers → Create & Edit and View and Manage AP/AR Data to move customers." (S4-N1). They can still make a default.”
